{{Vanilla|Crafting Table}}
{{Infobox auto}}
The '''crafting table''' is the block used to craft most items with a 3×3 grid. Its recipe and function are the same as in vanilla ''Minecraft''; Matcha Flavoured changes its appearance and a few of the rules around crafting.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Four planks of any wood make a crafting table, as in vanilla.

== Usage ==
The crafting table works as in vanilla. Nearly every custom item in the pack that is not cooked, smithed or cut is crafted on it.

Changes to crafting as a whole:
* '''Repairing is disabled.''' The vanilla recipe that combines two damaged tools into one is removed; equipment is repaired in an [[anvil]] instead.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> See [[Repairing]].
* '''Some crafts give back a glass bottle.''' Recipes that use a [[Glass Bottle#Water bottle|water bottle]], such as cloning flowers or making [[phosphor]], return the empty [[Glass Bottle|glass bottle]] to the player.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref> Food recipes that use a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]] or [[oil]] are meant to do the same, but in 1.12.2-beta most of them don't; see [[Glass Bottle#Returned from crafting]].
* '''Slabs craft back into blocks.''' Two slabs of almost any material craft into one full block, and chiseled blocks, which vanilla makes from slabs, move to the [[stonecutter]].<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.6-alpha|quote=All slabs can be crafted back into their original block}}</ref>

== Appearance ==
The resource pack retextures the block and its interface. The front of the table shows a small cabinet with drawers, and the top a round, pale work surface.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/textures/block/crafting_table_front.png}}</ref> In the crafting screen the 3×3 grid sits on a pale plate decorated with small pictograms, and the "Crafting" title is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/textures/gui/container/crafting_table.png}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref>
